summary: Learn WASH FIT assessment, service monitoring and corrective action for healthcare facilities. Explore the course and build practical facility tools.
lede: WASH in healthcare facilities training helps hospital and clinic managers, coordinators and engineers assess services and turn gaps into corrective actions. Participants practise scoring service levels, reviewing water and sanitation risks, checking hand-hygiene and cleaning readiness, and recording prioritized actions, owners and progress in a facility tracker.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for keeping healthcare-facility WASH services safe, available and monitored, or for supporting the people who do. It suits operational and programme roles that need to turn facility observations into assigned corrective actions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with healthcare-facility operations, WASH services, public-health programming or facility engineering is expected. No coding is required; basic spreadsheet use helps with monitoring exercises.
